name: Greenwich
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Greenwich?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. In Greenwich, a registered LSV may use roads posted 25 mph or less unless the traffic authority has closed that road. Greenwich has not permitted plain golf carts.

golf_cart.notes: Town traffic authority has not permitted them

lsv.notes: I-95 and the Merritt Parkway are closed

rules.rule: Plain golf carts are not street-legal unless the town traffic authority permits them
Registered LSVs on roads posted 25 mph or less, unless the traffic authority has prohibited that road
No LSVs on I-95 or the Merritt Parkway

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Greenwich?
faq.a: Roads posted 25 mph or less. I-95 and the Merritt Parkway are closed. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Greenwich?
faq.a: No. Connecticut only allows golf carts on public streets when that town's traffic authority permits them, and Greenwich has not.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV on a 25 mph street in Greenwich?
faq.a: Yes, if it is registered and the traffic authority has not prohibited that street. Roads posted over 25 mph are closed.
